"""Adversarial extreme-value instances."""
import random, math, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")
from gen import simple_paths, rand_weights


def extreme(rng, kind):
    if kind == "maxcap":
        n = rng.randint(3, 20)
        edges = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if i != j and rng.random() < 0.4:
                    edges.append({"tail": i, "head": j, "capacity": 1024})
        M = len(edges)
        coms = []
        total = 0
        tail = [e["tail"] for e in edges]; head = [e["head"] for e in edges]
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 30)):
            if n < 2: break
            s = rng.randrange(n); t = rng.randrange(n)
            if s == t: continue
            ps = simple_paths(tail, head, n, s, t, M, limit=20)
            if not ps: continue
            ps = ps[:min(16, 768 - total)]
            if not ps: break
            total += len(ps)
            coms.append({"source": s, "target": t, "demand": rng.choice([1024, 1, 512]),
                         "paths": ps, "previous": rand_weights(rng, len(ps))})
        budget = rng.choice([0, 1, 98304, rng.randint(0, 98304)])
        failed = rng.sample(range(M), rng.randint(0, max(1, M // 4))) if M else []
        return {"epoch": rng.randint(0, 2147483647), "node_count": n, "edges": edges,
                "commodities": coms, "failed_edges": failed, "budget": budget}
    if kind == "cap1":
        n = rng.randint(2, 12)
        edges = [{"tail": i, "head": (i + 1) % n, "capacity": 1} for i in range(n)]
        M = len(edges)
        coms = [{"source": 0, "target": (n - 1) % n if n > 1 else 1, "demand": 1,
                 "paths": [list(range(M - 1))], "previous": [16]}]
        return {"epoch": 1, "node_count": n, "edges": edges, "commodities": coms,
                "failed_edges": [], "budget": rng.choice([0, 100])}
    if kind == "parallel":
        M = 384
        edges = [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": rng.choice([1, 2, 1024])} for _ in range(M)]
        coms = [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 1024,
                 "paths": [[i] for i in range(16)],
                 "previous": rand_weights(rng, 16)}]
        return {"epoch": 2, "node_count": 2, "edges": edges, "commodities": coms,
                "failed_edges": rng.sample(range(M), rng.randint(0, 100)),
                "budget": rng.choice([0, 512, 98304])}
    if kind == "zeroheavy":
        n = rng.randint(2, 10)
        edges = [{"tail": i, "head": j, "capacity": 1}
                 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j][:384]
        M = len(edges)
        tail = [e["tail"] for e in edges]; head = [e["head"] for e in edges]
        coms = []
        total = 0
        for _ in range(40):
            s = rng.randrange(n); t = rng.randrange(n)
            if s == t: continue
            ps = simple_paths(tail, head, n, s, t, M, limit=20)[:16]
            if not ps: continue
            if total + len(ps) > 768: break
            total += len(ps)
            coms.append({"source": s, "target": t, "demand": 0, "paths": ps,
                         "previous": rand_weights(rng, len(ps))})
        return {"epoch": 3, "node_count": n, "edges": edges, "commodities": coms,
                "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}
    raise ValueError(kind)
PYEOF
